quarterly_data.quarter: Volex press release: Half Year Trading Update (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2027 trading update (six months to September 30, 2026): record first-half revenue expected of at least $710 million, including about $11 million from Kepler SignalTek (KST, acquisition completed July 2026), with organic constant-currency growth of at least 21% and growth in every end-market; first-half revenue about 7% above H2 FY2026 organically. Complex Industrial Technology grew significantly, led by aerospace and defence; about $10 million of revenue was pulled into H1 as customers built buffer stock ahead of the US site consolidation, due to complete by the end of the financial year. EV & Electrification grew very strongly on a greater share of the largest EV customer's requirements; Consumer Electricals and Medical returned to organic growth.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue at least $710 million; organic constant-currency growth at least 21%

quarterly_data.quarter: Volex press release: Half Year Trading Update (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data Centre (H1 FY2027 trading update): revenues well ahead of the prior year but below H2 FY2026, when Volex met customers' near-term capacity needs while other suppliers were supply constrained (it had secured key components early) and temporarily increased its share; supply conditions have since normalised. Underlying demand remains strong, and the transition to the next generation of higher-speed products, expected to ramp up during FY2028, is expected to support further growth.
quarterly_data.figure: next-generation higher-speed products expected to ramp during FY2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Volex press release: Half Year Trading Update (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (H1 FY2027 trading update): second-half revenue expected to be broadly similar to the first half after allowing for the revenue brought forward, with current trading conditions continuing in most end-markets; the Board expects FY2027 underlying operating profit towards the upper end of current market expectations, and the first-half underlying operating margin to show progress towards the 12% medium-term target.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 underlying operating profit towards the upper end of market expectations; 12% medium-term margin target
